review.visual: Every PDF page reviewed via rendered contact sheets; independent figures inspected. No whole-page substitute for body text.
review.pageBottom: All source page tails independently extracted and reviewed against full text; continuation tables,structures and final chapter retained.
review.translation: Full technical prose authored in English,Chinese,Russian,German; code/constants preserved.
review.figures: Chinese PDF only; all original technical image objects retained and source identified.
review.differences: Flowchart consists of two objects retained in order; Q&A source contains no answers.
review.excluded: Cover dates,legal/contact/audience and revision history omitted; technical version and scope retained.
review.limitations: No hardware execution,ArmSoM tests,network validation,site build,commit or push.
